requested_outcome: Make actionable administration metrics open the exact work list and add practical date and search-volume filters for pages awaiting approval.
natural_destination: VII admin dashboard, search-page center and content approval queue.
authorization_boundary: Implement and verify locally without publishing or changing production data.

lesson_bundle.reason: The administration interface must shorten real daily work rather than display passive numbers.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every actionable metric opens a matching management view and retains edit access.

lesson_bundle.reason: Metric links and filters must preserve the exact metric scope and period.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Pending, published, search and catalog numbers link only to views with matching data meaning.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request for every important number implies an affected-family inventory, not one hardcoded card.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Dashboard highlights, search-page metrics, content-queue summaries and growth pipeline are reviewed together.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The number looks clickable but opens an unfiltered generic page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Attach an explicit destination and query-state contract to each actionable metric.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The pending count opens the approval queue and the published count opens published search pages.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The displayed count and the destination list do not match.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the same status definitions and preserve period scope in the destination query.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Deep-link filters initialize from the URL and expose the matching filtered count.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Date filtering is ambiguous or excludes part of the selected end date.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Filter by last-seen calendar day in Israel and compare inclusive day boundaries.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Items on both selected boundary dates remain visible.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Search-volume filtering supports only one arbitrary threshold.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Provide minimum and maximum search counts with numeric validation and reset.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Minimum, maximum and combined ranges update the list and result count.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Filters are usable on desktop but overflow or become unreadable on mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a responsive advanced-filter grid and visible active-filter summary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The queue has no horizontal overflow at 390 pixels and all controls remain labeled.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A passive metric is given a misleading destination just to make everything clickable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Link only when a natural management destination exists and leave explanatory metrics passive.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every rendered metric link has a documented route; non-actionable ratios remain non-links.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the pending-count deep link and content-queue filters work, before expanding clickable metrics across the admin family.
checks: Open the pending count destination with retained URL filters.
Filter one fixture set by inclusive date and search-count range.
Confirm every filtered item still links directly to its editor.

attack_questions: Can a count open a list with a different status scope?
Can invalid or reversed numeric ranges hide all records without explanation?
Can an end-date item be incorrectly excluded?
Can a mobile user reach every filter and reset it?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Rendered admin queue and search-page center with deep-link state and direct edit links.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Admin metric-link and queue-filter tests plus responsive visual checks.

effectiveness.baseline: Important admin counts were passive and the approval queue only supported text and status filtering.
effectiveness.target: One click reaches the matching work list, while date and volume filters narrow approval work without losing edit access.
